definitions.explanation: The highest-ranking retainer serving a feudal lord (daimyō). The chief retainer managed domain affairs and acted as the lord's primary advisor. A key position in the feudal hierarchy of the Edo period.

examples.japanese: {家老|かろう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{藩|はん}→藩：14124_han⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{仕切|しき}った→取り仕切る：11946_torishikiru⟧。
examples.english: The chief retainer managed the domain's politics.

examples.japanese: ⟦{殿様|とのさま}→殿様：10455_tonosama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{留守|るす}→留守：01754_rusu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧、{家老|かろう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}った→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
examples.english: While the lord was away, the chief retainer guarded the castle.

examples.japanese: {筆頭|ひっとう}{家老|かろう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{藩主|はんしゅ}→藩主：26186_hanshu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{次|つ}ぐ→次ぐ：02076_tsugu⟧⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち→持つ：00478_motsu⟧、⟦{藩|はん}→藩：14124_han⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{財政|ざいせい}→財政：05757_zaisei⟧や⟦{軍事|ぐんじ}→軍事：14392_gunji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{統括|とうかつ}していた→統括する：22376_toukatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: The chief senior retainer held power second only to the domain lord and oversaw the domain's finances and military affairs.

notes:
USAGE:
A historical term from the feudal era, particularly the Edo period (1603–1868). Each domain (⟦{藩|はん}→藩：14124_han⟧) had several {家老|かろう}, with the {筆頭|ひっとう}{家老|かろう} (chief senior retainer) being the most powerful. The position was often hereditary.

In modern usage, {家老|かろう} appears mainly in historical dramas, novels, and history discussions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {筆頭|ひっとう}{家老|かろう}: chief senior retainer
- {家老|かろう}⟦{職|しょく}→職：00376_shoku⟧: position of chief retainer
- {国|くに}{家老|かろう}: domain-based chief retainer (stationed in the domain)
- ⟦{江戸|えど}→江戸：19369_edo⟧{家老|かろう}: Edo-based chief retainer (stationed in Edo)
